definitions.gloss: urban area; built-up area; city center; downtown area
definitions.explanation: An area within a city or town where buildings, shops, and residences are densely concentrated. Contrasts with residential suburbs, industrial zones, or rural areas.

examples.japanese: {市街地|しがいち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{交通量|こうつうりょう}→交通量：17876_koutsuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There is heavy traffic in the urban area.

examples.japanese: {市街地|しがいち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live a little away from the city center.

examples.japanese: {市街地|しがいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再開発|さいかいはつ}→再開発：17066_saikaihatsu⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}し→消す：00528_kesu⟧つつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Due to urban redevelopment, old shopping streets are gradually disappearing.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in urban planning, real estate, and news contexts. Also used in speed limit signs: {市街地|しがいち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時速|じそく}→時速：00128_jisoku⟧40km.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市街地|しがいち}⟦{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}→中心部：23774_chuushinbu⟧ (city center)
- {市街地|しがいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧ (urban development)
- {市街地|しがいち}⟦{走行|そうこう}→走行：14260_soukou⟧ (driving in urban areas)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{繁華街|はんかがい}→繁華街：09392_hankagai⟧: entertainment district — specifically the lively shopping and entertainment area
- ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧: city center — the very center or core of a large city
- ⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧: suburbs — the areas surrounding the urban center
